name: io.github.Luther22-source/overseer-mcp
title: Overseer MCP
description: IDE-as-Boss OpenRouter worker pool MCP server over stdio with live Monitor UI

environmentVariables.name: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Shared fallback OpenRouter API key (or store keys in <data_dir>/.env via overseer-mcp init)

environmentVariables.name: OPENROUTER_FREE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional OpenRouter API key dedicated to :free tier models

environmentVariables.name: OPENROUTER_CHEAP_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional OpenRouter API key dedicated to cheap tier models

environmentVariables.name: OPENROUTER_HEAVY_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional OpenRouter API key dedicated to heavy tier models

environmentVariables.name: OVERSEER_DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Optional override for the external Overseer data directory
